_about: Manifest for the measured-plant fixtures. Every number in host/pico_esc/measured.py traces to a
file listed here, and every file records which MECHANICAL CONFIGURATION and which ESC cross_up it
was recorded at — the two things that were previously implicit and got mixed.

_cross_up_provenance.claim: prop_350kv_20260726 datasets are cross_up=34; bare_shaft_350kv_20260730 are cross_up=36
why_it_needed_evidence: No fixture CSV carries a cross_up column (only duty_sweep.py stamps one, into its own output).
Git history looked like it said 36 for BOTH: the bench was recalibrated at cross_up=36 on
2026-07-26 17:46 (commit 011acf8), the prop-on dynamics dataset was committed 2026-07-27 00:17
(235eb56) with no reflash commit in between, the 2026-07-29 session note records cross_up=36 and
evidence: Two no-load duty sweeps recorded minutes apart at the two values: reports/duty_sweep_20260729_220535.csv
(A) and reports/duty_sweep_20260729_223122.csv (B). They are offset by EXACTLY 30 command counts at
every point (A: 780->2922.2, 570->753.2; B: 750->2932.2, 540->768.9) — a pure intercept shift, which
is what cross_rescale_duty does, and independent confirmation that cross_up moves the intercept and
Which sweep is which, pinned against a KNOWN cross_up rather than by assuming the sign: the ESC was
read directly and reports sine_cross_up: 36; at cmd 600 the encoder measured 1064.3 and 1069.3 rpm on
two independent runs. Sweep A interpolates to 1072.8 there (0.4-0.8 % away), sweep B to 1391.7 (30 %
away, far beyond any load effect - today is bare shaft and sweep A was prop-on). So A = 36, B = 34.
Interpolating both sweeps to the postfix sysid's three 6-step commands: measured 794.4 / 1510.4 /
cmd 680 against a directly-measured sweep whose own cross_up is pinned by a known-configuration
reconciliation_with_git: esctool.py flash WIPES the ESC config to firmware defaults and must be followed by re-applying the
whole config (a documented, recurring gotcha in this project). A flash between the 17:46 velcal and
the 00:17 sysid leaves NO commit trace, which is exactly why no reflash is visible in history. The
velcal commit message describes the config velcal ran under; the sysid that followed sat at the
also_derived: The 30-count offset over 2 cross_up units gives K = 0.00265*30/2 = 0.0398 duty/unit, between the
code's DUTY6_CROSSUP_K = 0.0421 and the theoretical 0.0391 — so the sign AND magnitude of the
existing term are sound. Sign convention (host/pico_esc/motor_model.py:duty6): a HIGHER cross_up
gives LOWER duty for the same command, so it needs MORE command for a given rpm. The 36 sweep needs

steptrace_down_noprop_20260730_033706.cs.trim: TIME-trimmed to the first 2.0 s per run; NOT decimated
steptrace_down_noprop_20260730_033706.cs.note: The half-time is 22-26 ms, i.e. ~5 samples, so decimating this file would destroy the one number it exists to measure. Source of SINE_PULLOUT_NM.

steptrace_startup_noprop_20260730_033906.note: Overshoot 53/53/54 %, t_peak 1.19/1.18/1.21 s, settles ~1206 rpm. tele reads exactly 0 for the first ~0.11 s and then 182 — the source of TELE_LIVE_S.

steptrace_startup2400_noprop_20260730_03.trim: time-trimmed to 4.0 s per run, then decimated 2x
steptrace_startup2400_noprop_20260730_03.note: Only 2 runs (not 3). Both ABORT_STALL: peak 657/742 rpm then zero. Source of STARTUP_ABORT_TARGET_RPM. The abort is gated on traversing the crossover gap, so it is strongly load-dependent.

coastdown_prop_20260730_211609.csv.spin_up: thrust 800 (OPEN loop) — the SAME protocol as coastdown_noprop_20260730_032130.csv
coastdown_prop_20260730_211609.csv.note: THE CONTROLLED PARTNER the inventory lacked. Source of J_PROP = 9.650e-6 and FREE_DECEL_PROP_RPM_S = 4089. Held OUT of the brake fit, so replaying its brake phase (1.88 rev median / 0.157 s from w_on 2544) with the bare-shaft-fitted L and cut-out is the only genuine out-of-sample check the brake law has.

sinesweep_prop_20260730_211856.csv.note: Controlled partner of sinesweep_noprop_20260730_033014.csv. `tele` is exactly 182.0 at every cmd <= 450 in BOTH configurations; worst spread 238/211 rpm vs bare 234/174 and the reversing region does not shrink — the propeller's inertia does NOT help the rotor follow the field.

sinesweep_fold_prop_20260730_212120.csv.note: Fine sweep cmd 495..555. Seam bracket cmd 525..530 on BOTH legs and in BOTH mechanical configurations, with no hysteresis resolved either way — the seam is load-independent.

steptrace_startup_prop_20260730_212401.c.command: rpm 1200 from rest (closed loop, --startup) — RECORDED in the `cmd` column
steptrace_startup_prop_20260730_212401.c.trim: time-trimmed to 4.0 s per run (matching the bare fixture's span), then decimated 4x
steptrace_startup_prop_20260730_212401.c.note: Controlled partner of steptrace_startup_noprop_20260730_033906.csv. On the committed fixtures, same 4 s span: overshoot 53/53/54 % vs bare 53/53/54 %, peak 1847-1853 vs 1839-1855 rpm, t_peak 1.20-1.23 vs 1.18-1.21 s. +27 % of inertia moves it under 1 pp.

steptrace_startup2400_prop_20260730_2124.command: rpm 2400 from rest (closed loop, --startup) — RECORDED in the `cmd` column
steptrace_startup2400_prop_20260730_2124.trim: time-trimmed to 1.6 s per run (the collapse is over by 1.31 s), then decimated 4x
steptrace_startup2400_prop_20260730_2124.note: ABORT_STALLs in all 3 runs, exactly as bare-shaft does. The expectation that the propeller's inertia would carry the rotor through the crossover gap is FALSIFIED: same failure, peak 700-827 vs bare 657-780 rpm. A CONTROL problem, not an inertia problem.

_spin_up_matters: RECORDED FROM 2026-07-30: every coastdown fixture now carries `spin_up`, because it is known to
matter. The original prop-on decay used a closed-loop `--rpm 2200` spin-up and starts at ~2210 rpm
while the bare-shaft set used open-loop `--thrust 800` and starts at ~3130, so the brake ENGAGES at a
different speed for a reason that has nothing to do with the propeller. Any bare-vs-prop comparison
drawn across those two is confounded. coastdown_prop_20260730_211609.csv is the protocol-matched
partner; the old file is kept because replaying it is what MEASURES the confound (and its w_on
tracking the START speed is a third independent confirmation of the fixed-delay brake).
